rationale: The first minutes after the 09:30 open set a range while opening orders clear; a break of that range shows which side holds the larger orders of the day, and price keeps going that way. Losing side: Traders who fade the first break and are forced out as the move continues.
notes: blocks ib_n: the 09:30 range of ib_min minutes (5 / 15 / 30 / 60), NY sessions only. break = OCO stop entries one tick beyond the range from max(range end, session start); fade = as ib (tgt_r unused). ib_min 60 = ib
